issues.description: The declaration of Bitmap24::resize_buffer in the header uses parameter types 'long i_width, long i_height' but the implementation in Bitmap24.cpp defines resize_buffer with parameters 'int i_width, int i_height'. This signature mismatch between header and source will cause linkage/compilation errors and confuses students about the intended API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the header and implementation signatures identical. Either change the declaration in Bitmap24.hpp to 'void resize_buffer(int i_width, int i_height);' or change the definition in Bitmap24.cpp to 'void Bitmap24::resize_buffer(long i_width, long i_height)'. Prefer aligning both to the narrower type 'int' (used elsewhere in the code) unless there is a documented reason to use 'long'.
